section_summary.extract_value: This section outlines the research hypotheses for a study validating the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) in Black college women and examining the role of ethnic identity in body appreciation. The study proposes five main hypotheses: (1) CFA will support a unidimensional BAS structure, (2) BAS scores will correlate positively with appearance satisfaction and self-esteem, (3) BAS scores will correlate negatively with Western beauty ideal internalization and eating disorder-related variables, (4) higher BAS scores will relate to stronger ethnic identity and lower eating disorder symptoms, and (5) ethnic identity's relationship with body and eating concerns will be mediated by Western beauty ideal internalization.
